items.text: Build a common remote-object ingestion interface.
Resume downloads where the protocol supports it.
Keep remote credentials out of the analysis sandbox.

Record bucket, object, generation, and checksum.
Support SAS tokens through secure credential storage.
Prevent redirects to loopback or private networks when inappropriate.

Keep private libraries local unless explicitly synchronized.

stages.title: Backend contract for the future GUI

items.text: This stage does not build the GUI. It makes the backend ready for one.
Separate application services from UI bridge code.
Define stable request and response schemas.
Ensure no response can accidentally contain a secret.
Ensure all user-facing errors are structured.
Generate view-ready capability data from the central registry.
Keep business logic outside future GUI code.
Add contract tests for every backend endpoint.
Freeze the first GUI-facing backend API.
